scope.summary: Implement the `history` command family over StudioHistoryEntry: history-query (list entries), undo, redo, revert-to-state, over the foundation per-file history stack (MT-011). Deduped from source undo/redo/versions surfaces into ONE model-visible family. Dry-run n/a for query; undo/redo are themselves ledger-recorded receipted commands (STUDIO_HISTORY_UNDONE/REDONE).
acceptance_criteria: history family on one contract; model-visible query; ledger-recorded undo/redo
expected_tests: live: history.query returns entries; history.undo/redo are ledger-recorded + replayable

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: History not model-drivable/queryable via the command contract.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
